subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Does the measured no-go complete this bundle investigation, or should one specific second route-boundary candidate be measured?
rationale: The issue’s stated acceptance criteria permit stopping after an unsuccessful first extraction, while selecting another candidate would extend the investigation without evidence that the next split will reduce the shared closure.

options.title: Accept the no-go
options.body: Treat the documented unchanged preload closure and reverted candidate as successful completion of the investigation and close the issue.

options.title: Define one second experiment
options.body: Keep the issue open only with a named import boundary, the same measurement protocol, a material reduction threshold, and another explicit stop condition.

recommendation.title: Accept the no-go
recommendation.body: Treat the documented unchanged preload closure and reverted candidate as successful completion of the investigation and close the issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the investigation, performed the controlled measurement, and own the most directly related recent route-performance history.
